王野继续溜达，从头走到尾都没有人卖粮食，王野心想，不可能呀！这么多人，怎么会一个卖粮食的都没有？就算是粮食紧张，总有人会有门路搞点出来卖的呀！

王野也不想继续找了，既然自己找不到卖粮食的，那就让卖粮食的找自己。王野可是有现在社会的硬通货，现在就没有什么东西是猪肉换不到的，有就是肉不够。

王野找了一个没人摆摊的地方，手伸进背篓里，从空间里拿出一个麻袋铺在地上，把小木牌放在麻袋上。然后在麻袋上摆上一块野猪肉，为了不让人猜测猪肉的来历，王野又把手伸进背篓里，从空间里拿出来了一个野猪头，这两样摆在一起，一看就知道是野猪肉。

刚摆上就有人来问了：“小兄弟，这野猪肉怎么卖？”

王野头也不抬说：“不卖，换粮食。”

问话的男人蹲下继续问：“怎么个换法儿？”

“一斤猪肉换两斤细粮或三斤粗粮，不要替代粮。”

男人拿出一个饭盒说：“这是三斤大米，你还有肉吗？”

王野从背篓里又拿出一条猪肉，同时手伸进后腰从空间里拿出短刀，把那块猪肉一分为二说：“一斤半猪肉，我没称你可以去称。”

男人从背篓里拿出来一把称说：“小兄弟，你看我这把称能换你这半斤肉不？”

王野抬起头看着男子，心想：“我擦，这货脑子转的挺快呀！一个新秤供销社才卖1块5，半斤肉现在卖两块钱都得抢着买。”

王野拿过秤，把剩下的半斤肉也递给男人，男人也把饭盒递给王野，王野又把手伸进背篓，从空间里拿出了一个小面袋子，把大米倒进面袋子里，又把饭盒还给男人，男人拿起饭盒转头就走了。

没一会儿，王野的摊位前就围了好几个人，当知道要用粮食换，很多人就垂头丧气的走了，但是还是有三个人换走了五斤肉，都是用的大米和白面。当人都走后王野的摊位前来了两个人，蹲下就问：“小兄弟，你还有多少肉？”

王野头都没抬顺嘴就问：“我有多少你能都要呀？”

“都要！”

王野听见这话抬起头，看见两人，一人蹲着带着头套，穿着不错最起码没有布丁，站着的身高得有一米九，长得好像一头熊站起来一样，这时代能长成这样也是奇葩了。

王野疑惑看着蹲下的男人，男人看出了王野的疑惑说：“我就是这个鸽子市的主人，这点实力还是有的！”

王野心想这是碰上二代了，在这个时期，家里没点背景，可弄不起一个鸽子市来。

王野也不怯场，说：“猪肉还有13斤，一斤换两斤；猪头18斤，一斤换一斤。”

男人也不还价，对着后面的大个子说：“大强，去取粮食”

“取多少？”

男人一拍脑门儿，忘了这货光长个子不长脑子：“取44斤！”

大个子“嗯”了一声转身就走，走出了两步又回来了，问：“哥，拿大米还是白面？”

王野都听见男人“咯吱咯吱”咬牙的声音了，王野憋着笑说：“大米就行。”

大个子看着男人没有动，男人叹了口气点了点头，大个子转头就跑了，男人尴尬的说：“让兄弟见笑了！我这兄弟脑子不太好使。”

王野：“赤子之心，挺好。”

男子听见王野的评价也挺高兴，说：“兄弟，以后再打到野猪，可以直接来鸽子市找我，跟看门的说找龙哥就行。”

没一会儿大个子就拿着一个袋子过来了，龙哥递给王野：“兄弟，称称吧！”

Wang Ye continued to walk, but no one was selling food from beginning to end. Wang Ye thought, it's impossible!With so many people, how come there is no one selling food?Even if food is tight, someone will always find a way to make some to sell!

Wang Ye didn't want to continue looking. Since he couldn't find the food seller, he would let the food seller find him.Wang Ye has the hard currency of today's society. There is nothing that cannot be exchanged for pork, but there is not enough meat.

Wang Ye found a place where no one was setting up a stall, reached into his backpack, took out a sack from the space, spread it on the ground, and placed a small wooden sign on the sack.Then a piece of wild boar meat was placed on the sack. In order to prevent people from guessing the origin of the pork, Wang Ye reached into the basket and took out a wild boar head from the space. Putting the two together, it was obvious that it was wild boar meat.

As soon as it was put on the table, someone came and asked, "Brother, how do you sell this wild boar meat?"

Wang Ye said without raising his head: "I won't sell it, but in exchange for food."

The man who asked the question knelt down and continued to ask: "How can I change it?"

"One pound of pork is exchanged for two pounds of fine grains or three pounds of coarse grains. Do not replace grains."

The man took out a lunch box and said, "This is three kilograms of rice. Do you still have any meat?"

Wang Ye took out another piece of pork from the basket on his back. At the same time, he reached into his lower back and took out a short knife from the space. He cut the piece of pork in two and said, "One and a half pounds of pork. I didn't weigh it. You can weigh it."

The man took out a scale from his backpack and said, "Little brother, do you think I can exchange this scale for your half a pound of meat?"

Wang Ye raised his head and looked at the man, thinking to himself: "Oh my God, this guy's brain is moving very fast! A new scale only costs 1.5 yuan at the supply and marketing cooperative, and half a kilogram of meat now costs 2 yuan. You have to rush to buy it."

Wang Ye took the scale and handed the remaining half a catty of meat to the man. The man also handed the lunch box to Wang Ye. Wang Ye reached into his backpack again, took out a small flour bag from the space, poured the rice into the flour bag, and returned the lunch box to the man. The man picked up the lunch box and turned around and left.

After a while, several people gathered in front of Wang Ye's stall. When they found out that they had to exchange food for food, many people left dejectedly. However, three people still exchanged five kilograms of meat for rice and white flour.After everyone left, two people came to Wang Ye's stall. They squatted down and asked, "Little brother, how much meat do you have left?"

Wang Ye didn't even raise his head and asked, "How much do I have that you can take?"

"All of them!"

Wang Ye raised his head when he heard these words and saw two people. One of them was squatting and wearing a hood. They were well dressed and at least had no pudding. They stood about 1.9 meters tall and looked like a bear standing up. It is strange to be like this in this era.

Wang Ye looked at the squatting man in confusion. The man noticed Wang Ye's confusion and said, "I am the owner of this pigeon market, and I still have some strength!"

Wang Ye thought he was meeting the second generation. At this time, his family had no background and could not afford to start a pigeon market.

Wang Ye was not afraid of the stage, and said: "There are still 13 kilograms of pork, one kilogram for two kilograms; there are 18 kilograms of pig head, one kilogram for one kilogram."

The man did not bargain and said to the big man behind him: "Daqiang, go get the food."

"How much to take?"

The man slapped his forehead, forgetting that this guy is tall but not smart: "Take 44 pounds!"

The big man said "Hmm" and turned around to leave. After taking two steps, he came back and asked, "Brother, do you want rice or flour?"

Wang Ye could hear the sound of the man grinding his teeth. Wang Ye suppressed a smile and said, "Rice will do."

The big man looked at the man and didn't move. The man sighed and nodded. The big man turned around and ran away. The man said awkwardly: "You made me laugh! My brother is not very smart."

Wang Ye: "It's good to have a pure heart."

The man was very happy to hear Wang Ye's comment and said, "Brother, if you hunt wild boars in the future, you can come directly to the pigeon market to find me. Just tell the gatekeeper to ask for Brother Long."

After a while, the big man came over with a bag. Brother Long handed it to Wang Ye: "Brother, please give it a shout!"
